raw_text: Statement from the Kuki Inpi Manipur (Tribal Body), May 3, 2023. The Kuki-Zo community condemns the unprovoked and coordinated attacks on our villages across Churachandpur, Kangpokpi, and Tengnoupal districts. Armed Meitei mobs, some in uniform, have systematically targeted Kuki settlements in the valley areas. Our people are being driven from their homes. We categorically reject the Manipur High Court's recommendation to grant Scheduled Tribe status to the Meitei community, which already dominates the valley and the state government. This order is the root cause of the current violence. We demand the immediate deployment of central forces and a judicial inquiry into the attacks.
